user.title: MyPolaris.ro
user.description: Choose how you want MyPolaris to authenticate.

menu_options.credentials: Email, password and CapSolver API key

credentials.title: MyPolaris.ro
credentials.description: Use this mode if you want the integration to log in automatically and refresh the ASP.NET session when needed. It requires your MyPolaris password and a CapSolver API key. If proxyless CapSolver tokens are rejected, add an HTTP proxy so CapSolver and MyPolaris use the same IP.

session_cookie.title: MyPolaris.ro
session_cookie.description: Recommended: sign in to the MyPolaris website in a browser, open the browser developer tools, find the Cookies section, copy the ASP.NET_SessionId value, and paste it below. For multiple MyPolaris accounts, use a separate incognito/private window or browser profile for each account before copying the cookie. Email is still required for the unique ID and entity naming.

error.invalid_api_key: API key must start with 'CAI-' or 'CAP-' and be at least 30 characters long.
error.invalid_proxy: Proxy URL must look like http://host:port or http://user:pass@host:port.

init.title: MyPolaris - Settings
init.description: For email login, update the CapSolver API key or optional HTTP proxy here. For browser-cookie login, paste a fresh ASP.NET_SessionId cookie if the session expires. You can keep the existing values for any fields you do not want to change.
